name: SUNO | 200mg Tablets | RSO + Maui Wowie
description:
Established out of a desire to improve patient well-being, SUNO products provide a robust custom cannabis platform.

Each tablet contains 10mg total cannabinoids and natural terpenes. SUNO products are also free of sugar, gluten, and nuts.

Custom ratios. Custom doses. Custom cannabis.
